verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a general programmatic API, client libraries, and an MCP server, but nothing describes bulk or batch operations that act on many items at once, such as bulk-muting monitors, batch-editing dashboards, or mass-updating tags. A general API is only a building block a developer could use to script bulk changes, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
